meta.title: Trash Can
meta.description: Move archived sessions into a restorable recycle bin and purge them after 360 hours.

trash.title: Trash
trash.emptyHint: Archived sessions appear here after you use Delete.

dialog.setupBody: Pick a directory that will hold sessions moved to the trash. It must be a local directory; nothing is created before you save.
dialog.deleteBody: "{title}" will move to the trash. It stays restorable for 15 days and is purged after 360 hours.
dialog.productsBody: These files were created or modified during the conversation. Deleting them cannot be undone; keep them to remove only the conversation.
dialog.productsNone: No files outside the conversation were found.
dialog.keepFilesAsk: Files kept. Continue deleting the conversation?
dialog.purgeBody: "{title}" and all of its files will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
dialog.clearBody: All {count} sessions in the trash will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
